### Background

NATS is an open source messaging system for cloud, on-premises and edge deployments.

NATS Server cluster peers exchange connection metadata when establishing routes. Routes can operate with or without connection pooling.

### Problem Description

Route pool metadata was not fully validated when a peer did not use pooling. A peer accepted on the cluster listener could cause an out-of-range access and terminate the server process. Cluster authentication limits who can reach the affected path; a compromised authorized peer can still trigger it.

### Affected Versions

The issue is fixed in v2.14.10 and v2.15.3. Earlier versions containing the affected functionality are vulnerable; the first affected version has not been established for this notice.

### Workarounds

Upgrade to a fixed release.

### References

 * GHSA advisory: <https://github.com/nats-io/nats-server/security/advisories/GHSA-4fpp-8grw-j976>
